name: Verifed V14.8
description: Batch 2 restaurant photography sourcing and quality audit for Tin & Taco, Mamak, The Stubborn Mule, Pig Floyd’s & Pigzza, and Lazy Moon. This release adds individually keyed sourced images, prioritizing named product photographs linked from Mamak's first-party menu and several distinct restaurant/ordering photographs from the other menus. The full 413-item inventory now records source evidence, item descriptions, candidate research queries, and missing or contextual photos. This is an interim GitHub-only photography update, NOT completion of all 413 photos.
verification: All 413 Batch 2 items are explicitly indexed in research/batch2-photo-audit.json.
The registry currently has 57 individual item photo references across Batch 2; approximately 356 records are still missing images.
Known restaurant-photo and contextual images are distinguished, and menu tiles never fill missing items with generic restaurant images.
URL checks indicate most image hosts serve image content; Pig Floyd's editorial image server can intermittently return HTML instead of an image.
Full visual checks, accurate alternatives for unmatched dishes, and third-party usage rights require further work. No AI-generated pictures or photo retouches are claimed.
Existing mobile contain-mode framing preserves whole-food images without cropping.
GitHub-only release; no new Expo Snack publication.
